description:
The patron type identified by pt‑001, titled **Graduate Student**, is defined for graduate students and grants them extended loan periods. Its detailed description reads: “Patron type for graduate students with access to extended loan periods.” This type is associated with the organisation whose record can be found at https://ils.rero.ch/api/organisations/uni-001, and the definition for this patron type is documented at https://ils.rero.ch/schemas/patron_types/patron_type-v0.0.1.json.  

A yearly subscription fee of 150.00 CHF applies to patrons linked to this type, reflecting the cost of the additional services provided.
